criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: PlayMusic
categories.definition: User wants to play music, songs, albums, or artists on a media player or streaming service.

categories.name: AddToPlaylist
categories.definition: User wants to add a track, song, album, or artist to a specific playlist or music collection.

categories.name: RateMedia
categories.definition: User wants to assign a score, rating, or stars to a book, album, novel, essay, or other media item.

categories.name: BookRestaurant
categories.definition: User wants to make a reservation or book a table at a restaurant, bar, or eatery.

categories.name: GetWeather
categories.definition: User wants to check the weather forecast, temperature, or specific weather conditions for a location or time.

categories.name: FindMovieShowtimes
categories.definition: User wants to find movie schedules, showtimes, or cinema listings for specific films or theaters.

categories.name: FindMedia
categories.definition: User wants to search for, find, or locate a specific book, movie, TV series, game, painting, or other media title.
